cond_0001.intro:
This role is in the Broker Strategy and Performance area working as a member of the Strategic project team.
The Strategic project team lead a variety of projects and initiatives that affect the whole Broker Division. These may be internal initiatives or wider projects that require the team to articulate the Broker business requirements to other areas of the [Company name masked] group such as IT and GI Transformation Teams.
The job holder will often be involved in many projects simultaneously, therefore strong time management and organisation skills are required. In addition the job holder will be working across [Company name masked] Broker and therefore must have a sound understanding of the Broker business model. Communication skills, a logical approach and great interpersonal skills are required to work as part of a cross functional team.
System changes (for example the [Product name masked] workstack) are overseen by this department. This role will be required to support the Broker Teams with the articulation of requirements, provide administrative support for these workstacks and co-ordinate with third parties to deliver change.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Be a key player in Broker Projects and be able to articulate the businesses requirements
Project manage changes from inception to implementation and monitor their benefits
Communication champion for projects and business as usual activities undertaken by Strategic project team
Transition planning for implementation of change delivered by system changes
Managing roll out of projects across [Company name masked] Broker
Support stakeholders with gathering business requirements for proposed changes and ensure they a properly documented
Own specific Small Change work streams
Co-ordinate relevant resources (eg IT, GI Transformation) to deliver projects and change
Manage relationships with 3rd party vendors
Provide support to all Strategic project team members with projects and business as usual activities as required
Support various projects that support the [Company name masked] Broker strategy.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Excellent organisational skills to deliver accurate work under pressure against agreed deadlines whilst remaining approachable
Proven track record to influence, negotiate and work with all levels of staff
Effective verbal and written communication skills with experience of influencing
Knowledge and understanding of insurance operations and statistics
Knowledge and understanding of the Broker Business model
Relevant experience in administration
Good PC skills and knowledge of management information systems
Good project management and coordination skills
Preferred Requirements
Good analytical review skills
Good presentation skills
Confidence to speak up and articulate opinions
Portray a professional image through approach and appearance
Responsibility and professionalism to work the hours needed to achieve the requirements of the role
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

The Strategic project team leads a variety of projects and initiatives affecting the whole Broker Division. These may be internal initiatives or wider projects that require the team to document and convey Broker business requirements to other areas of the [Company name masked] group, such as IT and GI Transformation Teams.
The job holder will often be involved in several projects at once, so strong time management and organisation skills are required. The role operates across [Company name masked] Broker and requires a sound understanding of the Broker business model. Clear written and verbal communication, a logical approach, and the ability to work within a cross-functional team are all needed.
System changes (for example the [Product name masked] workstack) are overseen by this department. This role supports Broker Teams with documenting requirements, provides administrative support for these workstacks, and coordinates with third parties to deliver change.
cond_0160.responsibilities:
Contribute to Broker Projects and document business requirements clearly
Project manage changes from inception to implementation and monitor their benefits
Produce and distribute project communications and updates for the Strategic project team's activities
Support transition planning for implementation of change delivered by system changes
Coordinate rollout of projects across [Company name masked] Broker
Support stakeholders with gathering and properly documenting business requirements for proposed changes
Own specific Small Change work streams
Coordinate relevant resources (e.g. IT, GI Transformation) to deliver projects and change
Manage relationships with 3rd party vendors
Provide support to Strategic project team members with projects and business as usual activities as required
Support various projects that underpin the [Company name masked] Broker strategy
cond_0160.requirements:
Excellent organisational skills to deliver accurate work under pressure against agreed deadlines
Proven track record of influencing and negotiating with staff at all levels
Effective written and verbal communication skills, with experience of influencing
Responsibility and professionalism to meet the demands of the role
Knowledge and understanding of insurance operations and statistics
Knowledge and understanding of the Broker business model
Relevant experience in administration
Professional approach and appearance
Good PC skills and knowledge of management information systems
Good project management and coordination skills
Good analytical review skills
Good presentation skills
Ability to clearly articulate views and provide input when required

The Strategic project team lead a variety of projects and initiatives that affect the whole Broker Division. These may be internal initiatives or wider projects that require the team to articulate the Broker business requirements to other areas of the [Company name masked] group such as IT and GI Transformation Teams.
The job holder will often be involved in many projects simultaneously, therefore strong time management and organisation skills are required. In addition the job holder will be working across [Company name masked] Broker and therefore must have a sound understanding of the Broker business model. Communication skills, a logical approach and great interpersonal skills are required to work as part of a cross functional team.
System changes (for example the [Product name masked] workstack) are overseen by this department. This role will be required to support the Broker Teams with the articulation of requirements, provide administrative support for these workstacks and co-ordinate with third parties to deliver change.
cond_0181.responsibilities:
Be a key player in Broker Projects and be able to articulate the businesses requirements
Project manage changes from inception to implementation and monitor their benefits
Communication champion for projects and business as usual activities undertaken by Strategic project team
Transition planning for implementation of change delivered by system changes
Managing roll out of projects across [Company name masked] Broker
Support stakeholders with gathering business requirements for proposed changes and ensure they a properly documented
Own specific Small Change work streams
Co-ordinate relevant resources (eg IT, GI Transformation) to deliver projects and change
Manage relationships with 3rd party vendors
Provide support to all Strategic project team members with projects and business as usual activities as required
Support various projects that support the [Company name masked] Broker strategy.
cond_0181.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Excellent organisational skills to deliver accurate work under pressure against agreed deadlines whilst remaining approachable
Proven track record to influence, negotiate and work with all levels of staff
Effective verbal and written communication skills with experience of influencing
Knowledge and understanding of insurance operations and statistics
Knowledge and understanding of the Broker Business model
Relevant experience in administration
Good PC skills and knowledge of management information systems
Good project management and coordination skills
Preferred Requirements
Good analytical review skills
Good presentation skills
Confidence to speak up and articulate opinions
Portray a professional image through approach and appearance

The Strategic project team leads a variety of projects and initiatives affecting the whole Broker Division. These may be internal initiatives or wider projects that require the team to document and convey Broker business requirements to other areas of the [Company name masked] group, such as IT and GI Transformation Teams.
The job holder will often be involved in several projects at once, so strong time management and organisation skills are needed. The role also requires a sound understanding of the Broker business model. Clear written and verbal communication, a logical approach, and the ability to work as part of a cross-functional team are all important.
System changes (for example the [Product name masked] workstack) are overseen by this department. This role supports Broker Teams with documenting requirements, provides administrative support for these workstacks, and coordinates with third parties to deliver change.
cond_0259.responsibilities:
Document and convey business requirements clearly as part of Broker projects
Project manage changes from inception to implementation and monitor their benefits
Handle communications for projects and business as usual activities undertaken by the Strategic project team
Support transition planning for implementation of change delivered by system changes
Coordinate rollout of projects across [Company name masked] Broker
Support stakeholders with gathering and properly documenting business requirements for proposed changes
Own specific Small Change work streams
Coordinate relevant resources (e.g. IT, GI Transformation) to deliver projects and change
Manage relationships with third-party vendors
Provide support to Strategic project team members with projects and business as usual activities as required
Support various projects that underpin the [Company name masked] Broker strategy
cond_0259.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Excellent organisational skills to deliver accurate work under pressure against agreed deadlines
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Knowledge and understanding of insurance operations and statistics
Knowledge and understanding of the Broker business model
Relevant experience in administration
Good PC skills and knowledge of management information systems
Good project management and coordination skills
Preferred Requirements
Proven track record of influencing and negotiating with staff at all levels
Good analytical review skills
Good presentation skills
Ability to articulate opinions clearly and with confidence
Professional approach and appearance

The team leads a variety of projects and initiatives affecting the whole Broker Division — both internal initiatives and wider projects that require articulating Broker business requirements to other areas of the [Company name masked] group, such as IT and GI Transformation Teams.
The role involves running multiple projects at once, so strong time management and organisation are essential. You will work across [Company name masked] Broker and must have a solid understanding of the Broker business model. Clear communication, a logical approach, and strong interpersonal skills are needed to operate effectively across a cross-functional team.
System changes (for example the [Product name masked] workstack) are overseen by this department. You will take ownership of supporting Broker Teams in articulating requirements, managing administrative tasks for these workstacks, and driving coordination with third parties to deliver change.
cond_0557.responsibilities:
Lead key Broker Projects and take ownership of articulating business requirements.
Direct project management of changes from inception through to implementation, and monitor their benefits.
Champion communication for projects and business-as-usual activities undertaken by the Strategic project team.
Own transition planning for the implementation of change delivered through system changes.
Drive the rollout of projects across [Company name masked] Broker.
Lead stakeholders through the process of gathering and properly documenting business requirements for proposed changes.
Take full ownership of specific Small Change work streams.
Directly coordinate relevant resources (e.g. IT, GI Transformation) to deliver projects and change.
Manage relationships with third-party vendors.
Deliver support to all Strategic project team members on projects and business-as-usual activities as required.
Execute on various projects that advance the [Company name masked] Broker strategy.
cond_0557.requirements:
Excellent organisational skills to deliver accurate work under pressure against agreed deadlines whilst remaining approachable.
Proven track record to influence, negotiate and work with all levels of staff.
Effective verbal and written communication skills with experience of influencing.
Responsibility and professionalism to work the hours needed to achieve the requirements of the role.
Knowledge and understanding of insurance operations and statistics.
Knowledge and understanding of the Broker Business model.
Relevant experience in administration.
Portray a professional image through approach and appearance.
Good PC skills and knowledge of management information systems.
Good project management and coordination skills.
Good analytical review skills.
Good presentation skills.
